description: Source code for Android device and WebView management in Playwright, including classes for Android, AndroidDevice, AndroidSocket, AndroidInput, and AndroidWebView, with methods for device control, WebView handling, and connection management.

classes.name: Android
classes.description: Represents an Android controller in Playwright, capable of connecting to devices and launching servers.

classes.name: AndroidDevice
classes.description: Represents an Android device, managing WebViews and device interactions.

classes.name: AndroidSocket
classes.description: Represents a socket connection to an Android device.

classes.name: AndroidInput
classes.description: Provides input actions (type, press, tap, swipe, drag) on an Android device.

classes.name: AndroidWebView
classes.description: Represents a WebView within an Android device, allowing access to its page.

methods.name: setDefaultTimeout
methods.description: Sets the default timeout for device operations.

methods.name: launchServer
methods.description: Launches an Android server if supported.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Connects to an Android device endpoint.

methods.name: serial
methods.description: Returns the serial number of the device.

methods.name: model
methods.description: Returns the model of the device.

methods.name: webViews
methods.description: Returns list of WebViews on the device.

methods.name: webView
methods.description: Finds a WebView matching criteria or waits for one.

methods.name: wait
methods.description: Waits for a specific device event.

methods.name: fill
methods.description: Fills text into a UI element.

methods.name: tap
methods.description: Simulates a tap on a UI element.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Retrieves information about a UI element.

methods.name: screenshot
methods.description: Takes a screenshot of the device.

methods.name: push
methods.description: Pushes a file to the device.

methods.name: launchBrowser
methods.description: Launches a browser in the device.

methods.name: toSelectorChannel
methods.description: Converts an AndroidSelector to a channel-compatible object.

methods.name: page
methods.description: Retrieves the page from a WebView.

methods.name: _fetchPage
methods.description: Fetches the page associated with a WebView.
